part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `diffElementNodes` (src/diff/index.js:341-349): for a freshly created `<progress value={0}>`, `dom.value` already reads `0` because an indeterminate progress element reports `0`, so the check `i !== dom.value` skipped the update and the `value` attribute was never written.

The fix mirrors upstream Preact: always apply the `value` update for `<progress>` elements when the value is falsy:

```js
(i !== dom.value || (dom.nodeName === 'PROGRESS' && !i))
```

Verified:
- `should set progress value to 0` (the FAIL_TO_PASS case) now passes
- Full browser suite: 883 passing, only 1 failure (`should use capturing for event props ending with *Capture`), which I confirmed also fails on the pristine tree (headless Chrome quirk, unrelated)
- Node/shared mocha suite: all passing
